publicRepositoryDescriptions..github: GrooveMap organization profile and shared community-health files.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.analytics-engine: Scheduled and precomputed music analytics with PostgreSQL and Valkey caching.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.automation: Reusable GitHub Actions workflows and composite actions for GrooveMap repositories.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.catalog-api: GrooveMap authentication, catalog search, graph query, recommendation, analytics, and operator API.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.database-schema: Versioned Neo4j and PostgreSQL schemas, runnable initialization, and compatibility contracts.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.deployment: Whole-stack Compose topology, production hardening, runtime configuration promotion, and deployment validation.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.design: GrooveMap brand sources, public architecture decisions, repository catalog, and canonical media taxonomy.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.discogs-graph-enricher: Consumes Discogs events and constructs the Neo4j music knowledge graph.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.discogs-ingestion: Downloads, verifies, parses, and normalizes Discogs dumps, then publishes source-owned events.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.discogs-sql-loader: Consumes Discogs events and builds PostgreSQL analytical tables.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.graph-explorer: Public-facing GrooveMap graph-exploration web application and catalog API proxy.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.groovemap-music.github.io: Static Astro organization website for groovemap.music.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.mcp-server: Client-run Model Context Protocol integration exposing GrooveMap through the catalog API.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.musicbrainz-graph-enricher: Consumes MusicBrainz events and enriches matched Neo4j entities.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.musicbrainz-ingestion: Downloads and verifies MusicBrainz dumps, enriches normalized JSONL, and publishes source-owned events.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.musicbrainz-sql-loader: Consumes MusicBrainz events and loads the complete dataset into PostgreSQL.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.operations-console: Privileged GrooveMap administration and monitoring web console.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.operations-toolkit: Credential-conscious, primarily observational queue, error, system, and deployment command-line utilities.
publicRepositoryDescriptions.python-libraries: Versioned Python runtime, resilience, and agent-tool libraries shared by GrooveMap services.
